translation.greek: Διὶ Ἡλίῳ μεγάλῳ Σαράπιδι καὶ τοῖς συννάοις θεοῖς. ἀξιοῖ Εὔφορος, εἰ ἀνακτήσωμαι, τοῦτό μοι δός.

context.notes: Classic health consultation with full divine titulature
context.curator_notes: Perfect example of Serapis health consultation formula

translation.greek: [Διὶ Ἡ]λίῳ μεγάλῳ Σαράπιδι [καὶ] τοῖς συννάοις [θε]οῖς. ἀξιοῖ Μένανδρος [εἰ] δέδοταί μοι γαμῆσαι. [τοῦ]το μοι δός.
translation.english: Is it granted me to marry?

context.original_paraphrase: Is it granted me to marry?
context.notes: Classic marriage inquiry with δέδοται formula
context.curator_notes: Beautiful marriage consultation - δέδοται formula is rare and important

translation.greek: Διὶ Ἡλίωι Σαράπιδι Νικαφόρωι. εἰ ἐπιτρέπεις μοι χρήσασθαι Ἑρμείνωι Ἑρμοπολίτηι ἰατρῶι πρὸς θεραπείαν τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν, καὶ τοῦτό μοι συμφέρει, τοῦτό μοι δός.
translation.english: Seeks permission to use Herminos (of Hermopolis) as a doctor for an eye condition.

context.original_paraphrase: Seeks permission to use Herminos (of Hermopolis) as a doctor for an eye condition.
context.notes: Detailed medical consultation with specific doctor and condition
context.curator_notes: Fascinating medical consultation - shows integration of divine and human healing

translation.greek: Κυρίῳ Σοκνοπαίῳ θεῷ μεγάλῳ καὶ Ἄμμωνι, θεοῖς μεγίστοις· ἀξιοῖ Σώτας, εἰ οὐ μέλλει ὁ νομάρχης ἐμαυτοῦ ἀγανακτεῖν ἢ ἐξετάζει τὰ κατ' ἐμέ, ὅτι τὰ πιττάκια Οὐαλερίου ἐγὼ γράφω, τοῦτό μοι δός.
translation.english: Asks whether the nomarch will be angry or examine him because he writes Valerius' pittakia.

context.original_paraphrase: Asks whether the nomarch will be angry or examine him because he writes Valerius' pittakia.
context.notes: Workplace anxiety consultation - very human and relatable
context.curator_notes: Unique administrative anxiety query - shows oracle use for bureaucratic concerns

translation.greek: [Διὶ Ἡλίῳ μεγάλῳ Σαράπιδι καὶ τοῖς συννάοις θεοῖς. ἀξιοῖ] Νίκη, εἰ συμφέρει αὐτῇ πρίασθαι Σαραπίωνα παῖδα παρὰ Τασαραπίωνος, [τοῦτό μοι δός].
translation.english: Asks if it is advantageous to buy a slave named Sarapion from Tasarapion.

context.original_paraphrase: Asks if it is advantageous to buy a slave named Sarapion from Tasarapion.
context.notes: Business transaction consultation about slave purchase
context.curator_notes: Economic consultation - shows oracle use for major financial decisions

translation.greek: Σαράπιδι καὶ Ἴσιδι καὶ πᾶσι θεοῖς. ἀξιοῖ Διονύσιος τὸν θεὸν περὶ τῆς ἀσθενείας αὐτοῦ, εἰ συμφέρει αὐτῷ ἀπελθεῖν ἐπὶ τὰ ἴδια.
translation.english: Dionysios asks the god about his illness, whether it is advantageous for him to return home.

context.original_paraphrase: Consultation about illness and whether to return home
context.notes: Travel consultation related to health concerns
context.curator_notes: Health/travel combination - common dilemma in ancient world

translation.greek: Διὶ Ἡλίῳ μεγάλῳ Σαράπιδι καὶ τοῖς συννάοις θεοῖς. περὶ γάμου. εἰ συμφέρει Διονυσίῳ γῆμαι Ἡραΐδα τὴν Ἡρακλείδου.
translation.english: Concerning marriage. Whether it is advantageous for Dionysios to marry Herais, daughter of Herakleides.

context.original_paraphrase: Marriage consultation about specific bride candidate
context.notes: Specific marriage partner consultation with family details
context.curator_notes: Detailed marriage query with actual names - great social history

translation.greek: Διὶ Ἡλίῳ μεγάλῳ Σαράπιδι. ἀξιοῖ Ἀπολλώνιος, εἰ συμφέρει αὐτῷ ἀντικαλεῖν Ἡρακλεῖδα περὶ τῶν ἐπικλήρων, τοῦτό μοι δός.
translation.english: Apollonios asks whether it is advantageous for him to counter-sue Herakleides about the inheritance claims.

context.original_paraphrase: Legal consultation about counter-suing in inheritance dispute
context.notes: Legal strategy consultation about inheritance litigation
context.curator_notes: Legal consultation - shows oracle use for litigation strategy
